data.one_liner: Manages native iOS and Android in-app review prompts with eligibility rules and diagnostics.
data.what_it_does: Invokes native StoreKit and Google Play in-app review dialogues based on configurable criteria such as install duration, session counts, and significant events. It tracks session lifecycle and reminder cooldowns persistently, preventing premature or repeated review requests. It also provides detailed diagnostic statuses for why a request was completed, suppressed, or failed.
use_when: You want to prompt users for App Store and Play Store reviews only after specific usage milestones or time delays are met.
You need detailed diagnostic results explaining whether a review request was completed, suppressed by conditions, or cancelled.
You need custom asynchronous logic to gate review dialog appearances.
avoid_when: You need desktop or web support for review flows.
You only need a simple button to launch the store listing without any eligibility tracking.
strengths: Built-in session monitoring that distinguishes meaningful sessions using background intervals rather than every resume event.
Rich diagnostic return statuses to understand why a review was or was not triggered.
Includes fallbacks for opening store listings directly when users click manual 'Rate this app' buttons.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
Requires high minimum environment versions (Flutter 3.47 / Dart 3.13 or newer).
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 24+ and iOS 13+. No extra Gradle review dependencies or iOS permissions needed.
